articles.title: What's real and what's fake? How AI is impacting Brazil's election race
articles.description: With just two days to go before the first round of Brazil's presidential election, artificial intelligence is taking centre stage, whether it's a deepfake avatar of former president Jair Bolsonaro to support his son's candidacy, or an AI-generated working-class female voter criticising President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. According to the Brazilian intelligence agency, disinformation will be one of the main challenges of this election. Our correspondents report.

articles.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai co-pilot was radicalised as UAE probes terror link
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Thursday the co-pilot accused of attacking a Flydubai flight carrying mostly Israelis had undergone “Islamist radical indoctrination”, as UAE authorities investigated a possible terror link. The captain and passengers overpowered the suspect before the plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday.

articles.title: US presses Europe to release diesel reserves 'immediately' as Trump threatens export ban
articles.description: The United States on Thursday urged European allies to release strategic diesel reserves immediately to curb prices driven higher by the US war on Iran. EU states will discuss a coordinated response on Friday, as Washington increases pressure following US President Donald Trump's suggestion that he could ban US diesel exports.

articles.title: L’inflation en zone euro au plus haut depuis trois ans
articles.description: L’augmentation des prix dans les 21 pays de la zone a atteint 3,8 % sur un an en septembre, selon la première estimation d’Eurostat, principalement en raison du bond des tarifs de l’énergie. Cette accélération pourrait conduire à une nouvelle hausse des taux d’intérêt.

articles.title: Eritrea cuts ties with Ethiopia over embassy closure
articles.description: Ethiopia ordered the closure of its embassy in Eritrea and declared 10 Eritrean diplomats persona non grata on Thursday, prompting Asmara to sever all diplomatic ties with its neighbour after overnight blasts heard in Addis Ababa sparked fears about renewed conflict in northern Ethiopia spreading. articles.title: Nigeria rolls out digital postcodes
articles.description: Nigeria’s Postal Service has launched a National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System. The system is designed to help Nigerians find the postcodes of locations across the country. Before now, house identification in Nigeria was based on an unreliable house numbering system. Locating places was difficult, time consuming and sometimes even expensive. But there may challenges using the new system in a country with poor urban planning and illegal building constructions.

C’est ce qui ressort d’un rapport accablant de la chambre régionale des comptes d’Occitanie.

articles.title: Why Brazil's gun lobby is backing Bolsonaro as country heads to polls
articles.description: As Brazil heads to the polls, one issue that could influence votes particularly in the rural south is access to firearms. Under Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil became more heavily armed than ever before: the number of registered hunters, shooters and collectors – known by the acronym ‘CACs’ – increased sevenfold in four years. Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva promised to reverse this trend, much to the irritation of the powerful gun lobby. France 24’s team in Brazil sent this report.
